Expansion Modules

Dakota Digital is proud to introduce the BIM Expansion modules for Dakota Digital RTX, HDX, VHX and VFD3 instrument systems. The Dakota Digital BIM-series modules allow you to add up to an additional 16 gauges, that's right we said SIXTEEN specialty gauge readings, to your vehicle without cutting extra holes in the dash or installing pillar and pod mounts in your interior.

Please note that the BIM modules are only compatible with current RTX, HDX, VHX, VFD3 and RET control boxes which have a black plastic housing. Control boxes with metal housings are not compatible with the BIM modules.
